info.headline: Notify NYC - Unplanned Road Closure - Harlem River Dr & Dyckman St (MN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-22-2026 at 10:32 PM.
Due to police activity, all southbound lanes of Harlem River Drive are closed at Dyckman Street in Manhattan. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnTjHH.
